request.text: I need help taking Claridi.ai to market. I built a strategic intelligence methodology, automated it into a reasoning engine, and realized the opportunity is much bigger than the original brand strategy use case. Claridi can help people make better decisions before they execute, and potentially serve as a strategy layer inside AI tools and business platforms. I’ve gotten it surprisingly far on my own, but I need guidance on protecting the IP, validating the business model, raising capital, building the right team, partnerships/licensing, and scaling it into a real company.
